verificationSummary: Editor merge commit 2b711c87e4bb036fa2c172550093dbd4fddc91ac implements the bounded Structure panel narrow-width visibility bugfix for the Editor design workspace. Pre-fix browser evidence at http://127.0.0.1:4001/documents/reorder-blocked-target-qa/design with a 704x880 viewport confirmed .outline-panel existed but computed outlineDisplay was none, outline width was 0, workspaceGridColumns was 704px, and console error count was 0. Focused RED failed npx vitest run src/tests/workspaceFrame.test.ts --reporter verbose because a max-width 980px media rule still hid .outline-panel. The fix changes src/styles/editor.css so the <=980px design workspace keeps two columns, Structure panel plus canvas, and only hides the right detail panel at that breakpoint. Focused GREEN passed npx vitest run src/tests/workspaceFrame.test.ts --reporter verbose with 1 file and 2 tests. Worktree browser evidence in live Backend mode at http://127.0.0.1:57257/documents/reorder-blocked-target-qa/design with Backend http://127.0.0.1:57256 and viewport 704x880 reported outlineDisplay grid, outline width 280, sideDisplay none, workspaceGridColumns 280px 424px, and 0 console errors. Editor worktree npm run check passed type-check, 90 passed test files, 313 passed tests, and build. Merged Editor main npm run check passed type-check, 90 passed test files, 313 passed tests, and build. Main browser evidence in live Backend mode at http://127.0.0.1:58516/documents/reorder-blocked-target-qa/design with Backend http://127.0.0.1:58515 and viewport 704x880 reported outlineDisplay grid, outline width 280, sideDisplay none, workspaceGridColumns 280px 424px, and 0 console errors. Vite still reports the existing chunk-size warning. Editor npm install in the lane still reported 5 high severity vulnerabilities. Project Control baseline npm run check passed check:data, type-check, 58 test files, 329 tests, build, and 6 e2e tests before record edits. Project Control focused record tests passed npx vitest run tests/editor-structure-panel-narrow-width-visibility-lane.test.ts tests/project-roadmap-work-queue.test.ts --reporter verbose with 2 files and 3 tests after records were added. Project Control record gate first stopped with PROJECT_INDEX_STALE until npm run generate was run. The next Project Control gate reached tests and failed 14 existing Editor lane tests because their exact Editor workIds lists did not include editor-structure-panel-narrow-width-visibility. After updating only those expected lists, focused Project Control lane verification passed npx vitest run tests/editor-structure-panel-narrow-width-visibility-lane.test.ts tests/editor-creator-structure-add-affordance-foundation-lane.test.ts tests/project-roadmap-work-queue.test.ts --reporter verbose with 3 files and 4 tests. Project Control record gate npm run check passed check:data, type-check, 59 test files, 330 tests, build, and 6 e2e tests after records and tests were added. git deregistered the Editor worktree and branch deletion succeeded, but the residual .worktrees/editor-structure-panel-narrow-width-visibility folder could not be removed because a verified recursive cleanup command was rejected by local command policy. Previous residual Editor worktree folders for editor-creator-structure-add-affordance-foundation, editor-inspector-detail-navigation-foundation, editor-outline-scannability-foundation, and editor-selection-context-summary-foundation remain local cleanup risks. This evidence supports only the bounded Editor design workspace Structure panel visibility at the narrow desktop breakpoint. It does not promote broad Editor truth, WYSIWYG readiness, text input readiness, active add-block creation, command authoring readiness, Backend mutation or persistence readiness, Backend production readiness, Core truth, real large-document authoring performance readiness, accessibility readiness, full visual regression readiness, durable storage readiness, PDF export readiness, bundle-size readiness, mobile readiness, live production behavior, or FlowDoc product readiness.
